content.help: ON (default): the 35-class tree (tier 1 to 4, mastery, free switching) is active for the followers you give a class. OFF: today's three classes (Melee, Ranged, Mage) exactly; stored class progress is kept untouched. Needs this plugin loaded.

ON (default): a follower with a class equipped follows it strictly (his gambits, weapon and spell choices stay inside the class). OFF: the class only adds its passive. Only means anything while the class tree is ON.
ON (default): show the follower's class and level in the combat display. OFF: hide it. (The setting is stored now; the display itself is not built yet.)
Multiplier on all class XP. 1.0 (default) is the sized pace: a tier 1 class masters in about 3 hours of play, tier 2 in 6, tier 3 in 10, tier 4 in 13. 2.0 halves those hours, 0 stops class XP.
Damage per second the Priest's sun does to undead and Daedra within 6 metres (default 2).
Health per second the Saint's healing aura gives allies (default 30).
Damage per second the Saint's aura does to undead (default 30).
